title: MPA Declaration Bundle
description: The auditor-facing contract produced by mpa-conform. The mpa-auditor accepts declaration_bundle.json and only declaration_bundle.json from researchers (mpa-auditor/docs/foundational-answers.md §Q12 correction note, 2026-05-15). Two operators produce these: the curator (deriving from committed library cells -> tier 'curated') and the researcher (raw upload -> signed -> tier 'user'). v0.1 carries the full signing strata as forward-compatible fields; first-session curator output uses minimal manifest_hash + signed_by.
_extension_note: Closed at top level on purpose: the declaration bundle is a versioned exchange contract. Add fields via schema version bump (v0.2, v0.3, ...). Open-typed extension lives only in declaration_trail entries and metadata blocks (provenance.notes, observable.metadata, declaration_assistant.metadata).

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Auditor switches import logic on this.

tier.description: Curator-path bundles are 'curated' (committed seed-corpus); researcher-path bundles are 'user' (declaration-driven, validation-status fenced).

signature.description: v0.1: minimal manifest-hash + signer name is sufficient. Forward-compat fields (algorithm, canonical_form, envelope, pubkey_fingerprint) are declared but optional; v0.2 will require them when the Ed25519/JCS/DSSE stack lands.

manifest_hash.description: Hex digest of the canonicalized bundle body (everything except this signature object). v0.1: SHA-256. v0.2+: BLAKE3.

signed_by.description: Curator name (curated tier) or researcher identifier / ORCID (user tier).

algorithm.description: v0.1 default 'none' (manifest_hash + signed_by only); v0.2 'ed25519-dsse-intoto' becomes required.

canonical_form.description: Canonicalization used before hashing. v0.1 'json-stable-keys' (sorted keys, no whitespace); v0.2 'jcs-rfc8785'.

envelope.description: v0.2: DSSE envelope around in-toto Statement. v0.1: null.

pubkey_fingerprint.description: Ed25519 public-key fingerprint. v0.2+: required when algorithm != 'none'.

substrate_class.description: Class id from mpa-auditor/corpus/substrate-classes.json, or 'unclassified'. 'unclassified' is real and supported (per mpa-auditor §Q9).

xdot_choice.description: Substrate-native rate-variable choice. Free-form string (substrate-conditional); e.g. 'spin-flip', 'detection-event', 'position-relative', 'velocity'.

value.description: Numerical tau_obs (the observer camera). null permitted only if method='swept' or 'aggregated'.

method.description: How tau_obs was chosen. 'declared' = researcher named it; 'swept' = bundle covers a range; 'aggregated' = window-aggregated reading (top-level C_mean/chi_mean from library cells); 'defaulted' = curator/conform tool picked a substrate-default.

provenance.description: ATTRIBUTION IS MANDATORY (load-bearing per mpa-auditor README). Mirrors contract-05 provenance shape so auditor import is mechanical.

doi_verified.description: Did mpa-conform verify the DOI against DataCite/Crossref/OpenAlex at conform time? false for v0.1 curator path; researcher path will populate via openalex-mcp-server (per unified report §1).

license.description: SPDX identifier or one of: 'public_domain', 'permission_granted', 'unknown'. NEVER null — if unknown, say so.

coverage_range.description: Min/max of values actually present in the rows (per mpa-auditor §Q1).

validity_range.description: Min/max where the column is declared instrument-valid. Defaults to coverage_range when not separately declared.

range_source.description: honesty marker: 'declared' = researcher named the validity range; 'computed' = defaulted to coverage.

observable.description: Canonical (tau, C, chi) gFDR observable. After mpa-conform processing, format is always 'canonical_fdr' — raw time-series, if uploaded, was passed through the windowed-correlator upstream and the (tau, C, chi) triples emitted here. Curator path: extracted directly from library cell's all_samples (t -> tau, C_mean -> C, chi_mean -> chi, SEM -> uncertainty).

data.description: Row-oriented (tau, C, chi[, optional uncertainties]) triples. One row per t_sample point.

n_realizations.description: Ensemble size if the observable was aggregated. null if not applicable.

scalar_observables.description: Optional scalar observables beyond the (tau, C, chi) sequence. Mirrors mpa-auditor's contract-05 scalar_observables extension; rides the same shape so import is mechanical. Examples: phase_locking_r for gamma_AB constraints (per mpa-auditor M-Inversion proper).

fit_provenance.description: Optional curator-path leading-order canonical-parameter estimate (chit, gamma_AB) at the operating point. The auditor still fits its own canonical parameters; this is a declared hint and lookup-table seed for driver-profile.translation_field. NOT a researcher-path field.

declaration_trail.description: Per-decision provenance: who answered what, when, with what tool. Echoes into mpa-auditor's AuditDelta as the declaration trail (per mpa-auditor §Q9).

declaration_assistant.description: Present iff an LLM/MCP stack was used to fill the bundle (i.e. researcher path, never curator path). v0.1: shape sketched; v0.2 will lock it down once the bundled-LLM stack (Gemma-3-4B / qwen25-3b-openclaw) and MCP picks (openalex-mcp-server, citecheck, pint-wrapper) settle per unified report §2 + §1.

secondary_model.description: N-of-2 consistency check pair model (per unified report §5).

pydantic_retries.description: Number of validation-feedback retries before bundle was accepted (per unified report §5 'Pydantic at the boundary').

raw_data_archive_ref.description: Optional pointer to the raw time-series archive (e.g. 'ipfs://...', 'zenodo:10.5281/...', 'local://...'). Bundle is self-contained without it; this is for reproducibility, not for re-processing.

version_context.description: Versions of the conform tool, MCPs, and models that produced this bundle. Mirrors mpa-auditor's AuditDelta.version_context shape so the auditor surfaces conform-side staleness symmetrically.
